summary: Describes an experiment in remote printing that uses ordinary Internet mail to carry a document to a printer connected to the telephone network, such as a fax machine. The idea is to let mail infrastructure do the long-distance delivery. It was replaced by RFC 1528, RFC 1529.

eli5.summary: Instead of driving a paper to a faraway office, you email it, and a machine near the other person prints it out for them.

questions: how to send mail to a fax machine
